elements_selected.content: Author a standalone Rust spike (in tools/ or examples/) that exercises diamond-types' OpLog/Branch APIs for: insert, delete, save/load, fork/merge, char-position addressing. Document gaps vs the current automerge usage in src/crdt/mod.rs and src/web/ws.rs. Capture findings in research/diamond-types-spike.md including: minimum supported version, wire-format size compared to automerge, and a recommended marks-layering strategy.
